asset_feed_spec_limits.rule: Validate before any adcreative submission; MVP single-creative path should avoid dynamic asset-feed unless explicitly enabled.

rules.check: reuse criativo_master by content hash and record only an account-scoped trafego_meta_asset_upload association
sniff MIME and compare extension/declared MIME
placement-specific size/aspect constraints must cite source/date; volatile specs not frozen without source

storage_rule: The ZIP importer may create/reuse criativo_master locally. meta_image_hash and meta_video_id are never master fields; they are outputs of separately authorized uploads.
